fee_notes: Royalty Fee is 6% of Gross Sales for standard territories (>30,000 households); Hometown Markets with ≤30,000 households pay a flat $750/month royalty. Minimum Royalty Payment phases in: $250/month beginning in the 4th full calendar month after Operations Commencement, $500/month beginning in the 16th full calendar month, $750/month beginning in the 28th full calendar month. Technology Fee (Zr Ware) is 2.25% of Gross Sales, may increase up to 0.5%/year, capped at 3.5% during the initial term — this is a % of Gross Sales, not a flat monthly fee, so it is not captured in tech_fee_monthly. National Brand Fund Contribution is currently 1% of Gross Sales, may increase by up to 1% per annum to a maximum of 3%. Some early franchisees pay lower royalty and/or brand fund rates under legacy agreements. Late Fee: 2% of royalty payment if not received by the 20th; additional 2%/month interest if not received by the 30th. Non-Compliance Fee: $100/day per deviation plus actual expenses. Transfer Fee: $7,500 (intra-system transfer) to $30,000 (new franchisee). Training Fee: $1,500/person for additional attendees.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Fee ("Royalty Fee") | 6% of Gross Sales, subject to minimum amounts. If your Operating Territory is a Hometown Market the royalty amount is a $750 per month flat fee, subject to minimum amounts. (Note 1) | By the 15th of each month based upon the Gross Sales for the prior month | You will pay your Royalty Fee to us through an Electronic Funds Transfer ("EFT").
Zr Ware Technology Fee | 2.25% of Gross Sales, may increase by up to 0.5% per year, provided that it will not exceed 3.5% during your initial term | By the 15th of each month based upon the Gross Sales for the prior month | (Note 2)
National Brand Fund Contribution | 1% of Gross Sales currently, up to 3% of Gross Sales | By the 15th of each month based upon the Gross Sales for the prior month | The required contribution is currently 1%. You will pay your national advertising contribution to us through an EFT (Note 3).
Non-Compliance Fee | $100 per day per deviation from contractual requirement plus actual, reasonable expenses incurred related to ensuring compliance, if applicable | After notice and opportunity to cure within 10 days, within five days after notification from us that the fee is being charged |
Late Charges | 2% of late royalty payment if received after the 20th of the month; 2% per month interest on unpaid balances | Immediately after notice from us | (Note 1)
Training Fee for Additional Persons | $1,500 per person | At time of training | (Note 4)
Additional Training/Assistance | $250 per day plus expenses | As incurred | We charge a daily fee of $250 plus expenses for any special assistance you request.
Transfer Fee | $7,500 - $30,000 | Before Transfer is effective | (Note 5)
Audit Expenses | Cost of audit, plus late fees | Immediately after notice from us | You must pay this fee only if the audit shows that you understated your Gross Sales by more than 2%.
Services We Provide to Your Customers | Varies | As incurred | (Note 6)
Annual Conference Fee | Varies | As incurred | (Note 7)
National Customer Acquisition Fee | Varies | By the 15th of each month to be paid with the Royalty Fee | (Note 8)
